leadText:
J's henchmen are men who help Pokémon Hunter J in her crimes. They first appeared in Mutiny in the Bounty!. 

Only two of J's henchmen are shown to have their own . These particular henchmen catalogue all of the Pokémon J has stolen. One of them used a to Ash's Pikachu before , Jessie, and James attempted to sneak off J's airborne base after rescuing Pikachu, 's , and Melodi's . Some of these henchmen were captured by Officer Jenny at the end of their first appearance. The ones that weren't captured appeared in Ill-Will Hunting!. In this episode, the other important henchman appeared, also using a Golbat to fight Pikachu.

These same henchmen reappeared in Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! Part 1 and Part 2, where more of their Pokémon appeared. They appeared once more in Pillars of Friendship!, with even more of their Pokémon.

The henchmen made a brief appearance in The Needs of the Three! alongside J after her successful mission to capture , , and . They were aboard her ship when it was destroyed by the . It is unknown whether any of the henchmen were able to get off the ship before it exploded.
